message: Third Part of the reallocation - InternalTickets, CalendarEvents and Feedbacks. The query for the listing of InternalTickets used a criteria to ample, which has been reduced to be only the tickets where the current consultant is the subject_owner; As for the reallocation, it moves all tickets that are related to the product proposal of the client to the new consultant.
